"literal": "Rise and grind.",
"adaptation": "Rise and brew", 
"back_translation": "Rise and brew", 
"approach": "adapted", 
"notes": "While 'grind' is colloquially understood in UK English to mean working hard, changing it to 'brew' adds a direct connection to the product (coffee) and maintains the activeness associated with 'rise'. There are no specific cultural issues affected by this change."
